# aeneid-024 — new house renderings

|---|---|---|---|
| IV.23 | *adgnosco veteris vestigia flammae* | "I recognise the footprints of an old flame" | "I know again the tracks of a fire that once burned in me" |

No other new house renderings.

(Reviewer, 2026-11: the drafter's `l` "I acknowledge the spoor of an old flame" and `i` "I know the marks that an old fire left on me" were replaced. `i` kept "marks" and "old fire" from the best-known versions; `l` used "spoor" for *vestigia*, which is not the plain word. The renderings above are built from the Latin; no modern translation was opened. Final decision stays with the owner.)
